scope: Three new playable forms: rolling-ball / marble-chain / surveillance. Existing forms were preserved; this is not a quality audit of every historical demo.

roll.title: 云廊滚球
visual_corrections: Close follow camera during play with an overview toggle
Teal glass and brass ball, continuous limestone and brass course
Hide duplicate canvas heading and meter on narrow screens
browser_verified: Pause freezes elapsed time and disables controls
Refresh restores elapsed time and progress

chain.title: 琉光回廊
visual_corrections: Original observatory garden and glass crystal artwork
Reduce heavy grey track to a subtle stone groove and thin brass inlay
Readable current and next ammunition with 46px controls
browser_verified: A matched shot clears three crystals: 35 plus one minus three equals 33 remaining, 360 score
Refresh restores 33 remaining, 3 cleared and 360 score

watch.title: 夜潮值守
visual_corrections: Four consistent authored rainy coastal camera scenes
Moving characters, rain, working beam and gate
Readable external power, time and character meters
Explicit successful handover and failed recording states
browser_verified: Lamp and gate affect power and events
Failure from leaving the generator gate open
Complete 72-second successful shift: worker arrives, generator safe, 45 percent power remaining
Refresh restores completed state and disables controls

shared_corrections: Align scene and module controls in standalone and embedded views
Use a vertical layout for new fullscreen players
Reserve a 56px fullscreen exit header to avoid hiding timers
Make paused Continue and Exit controls distinct
Catalog covers are exact captures from the actual rendered demos

browser_console.fresh_comparison_parent_error: Uncaught TypeError: Failed to execute 'observe' on 'MutationObserver': parameter 1 is not of type 'Node'.
browser_console.parent_error_provenance: Unknown; this observer error was also seen on the pre-existing comparison page and no matching observer implementation was found in project source. Embedded modules nevertheless loaded and rendered. The error was not suppressed.

limits: Responsive validation uses a browser viewport override, not real-device performance testing
Audio implementation was checked but audible quality was not listened to
This review does not establish commercial completeness or quality of all 43 forms
